mods.name: Storage Drawers
mods.description: Multi-drawer storage blocks for quick storage and retrieval.

releases.notes:
- Fix empty locked drawer getting cleared on chunk reload
- Fix UI rendering / blanking items with 0 count
- Crash mitigation and logging in a broken mod environment
- Fixed items not being accepted by full compacting drawers when void upgrade present.
- Protect against storage upgrades with illegal level values.

- Fixed compacting drawers sometimes populating with wrong conversion rates.
- Fixed empty drawers getting set to an item during a simulated insert.
- Fixed empty drawers not always accepting full item amount if void upgrade present.
- Fixed maybe something else with IItemHandler capability.
- Added some debug commands to simulate item insertion.
- Possible fix for controllers rarely not building the storage network
- Possible fix for controllers rarely not building the storage network
- Added additional log output for debugging controllers

- Parity with 3.5.15,
- Basically a bunch of bugfixes.
- Requires Chameleon 3.0.2+
- Reduce amount of block re-rendering when inserting or removing items
- Probably fix a rare render crash?

- Add framed trim
- Requires Chameleon 1.1.4+

- Restored WAILA integration.
- Previous fixes from 1.8.9 and 1.7.10.

- Fixed crash when removing a drawer from a controller network while other systems are using it.
- Fixed framing table allowing players to dupe raw drawers.
- Fixed framing table refusing to craft in some cases.
- Fixed status upgrade crashing client when placed on framed drawers.
- Performance improvement in controller interactions with some mods.
- Minor rendering adjustments.
- Fix permanent render crash when framing drawers with blocks that don't return valid icons.

- Fixed custom drawers dropping as regular drawers.
- Fixed various rendering problems with custom drawers.
- Port to Minecraft 1.8.8
- Fix mod for Forge 1499 and later.
